svg.title: Four checks before traffic is purchased
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-contact-and-counterparty-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four checks before traffic is purchased; subtitle: Pass each check in sequence; a failed branch stops the affected route.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values encode ordered check positions, not risk scores. The FCC's 2023 one-to-one consent amendment was vacated in Insurance Marketing Coalition Ltd. v. FCC, 127 F.4th 303 (11th Cir. 2025); do not present it as an operative universal FCC mandate. Recipient-specific evidence remains a useful contractual control. Confirm current rule text and controlling decisions before activating a jurisdiction or product.; caption: Pass proceeds to the next check; failure disables the relevant campaign or recipient until the specified defect is corrected. Commercial risk checks supplement statutory requirements.; stages: label: Contact method and permission; value: Pass to Medicare scope; fail to contact redesign; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Classify consumer-initiated inbound activity, transfers, and outbound follow-up separately under 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, and applicable 16 CFR Part 310 provisions. Apply written-consent requirements where triggered. Refresh DNC suppression as required, including the applicable 31-day National Registry update interval, and check entity-specific suppression before outbound contact.; label: Medicare marketing requirements; value: Pass to state restrictions; fail to appointment repair; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For Medicare activity, apply 42 CFR 422.2264 and 423.2264 scope-of-appointment timing, including the 48-hour rule and its actual exceptions. Apply TPMO marketing, sales, and enrollment call-recording rules under 422.2274 and 423.2274, plus applicable individual TPMO information-sharing permission requirements. Non-Medicare routes proceed without importing these rules.; label: State recording and legal advertising; value: Pass to buyer risk; fail to route exclusion; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Map caller and recipient jurisdictions before recording; California Penal Code section 632 addresses confidential communications. For legal inquiries, examine applicable state advertising, solicitation, referral-payment, and runner restrictions, including California Business and Professions Code sections 6151–6153 when relevant. Exclude arrangements that fail the governing rules.; label: Buyer collectability and acquisition risk; value: Pass to capped traffic; fail to funding repair; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document the connected-time clock, rejection reasons, dispute window, credit exposure, and actual net-7 collections. Set CPC and publisher exposure limits from realized contribution, not headline bids. At Base Case, a 10% acquisition-cost increase with everything else fixed removes $38,250 and reduces profit to $161,500.

text.tspan: Four checks before traffic is purchased

circle.title: label: Contact method and permission; value: Pass to Medicare scope; fail to contact redesign; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Classify consumer-initiated inbound activity, transfers, and outbound follow-up separately under 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, and applicable 16 CFR Part 310 provisions. Apply written-consent requirements where triggered. Refresh DNC suppression as required, including the applicable 31-day National Registry update interval, and check entity-specific suppression before outbound contact.

text.title: Classify consumer-initiated inbound activity, transfers, and outbound follow-up separately under 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, and applicable 16 CFR Part 310 provisions. Apply written-consent requirements where triggered. Refresh DNC suppression as required, including the applicable 31-day National Registry update interval, and check entity-specific suppression before outbound contact.

circle.title: label: Medicare marketing requirements; value: Pass to state restrictions; fail to appointment repair; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For Medicare activity, apply 42 CFR 422.2264 and 423.2264 scope-of-appointment timing, including the 48-hour rule and its actual exceptions. Apply TPMO marketing, sales, and enrollment call-recording rules under 422.2274 and 423.2274, plus applicable individual TPMO information-sharing permission requirements. Non-Medicare routes proceed without importing these rules.

text.title: For Medicare activity, apply 42 CFR 422.2264 and 423.2264 scope-of-appointment timing, including the 48-hour rule and its actual exceptions. Non-Medicare routes proceed without importing these rules.

circle.title: label: State recording and legal advertising; value: Pass to buyer risk; fail to route exclusion; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Map caller and recipient jurisdictions before recording; California Penal Code section 632 addresses confidential communications. For legal inquiries, examine applicable state advertising, solicitation, referral-payment, and runner restrictions, including California Business and Professions Code sections 6151–6153 when relevant. Exclude arrangements that fail the governing rules.

Set CPC and publisher exposure limits from realized contribution, not headline bids. At Base Case, a 10% acquisition-cost increase with everything else fixed removes $38,250 and reduces profit to $161,500.
